entries.BeforeUpdateSQL:
declare @SheetNo VARCHAR(50),@SheetSeries1 VARCHAR(50),@SheetStatus SMALLINT,@Count int,@Message VARCHAR(200),@ireturn INT 


SET @ireturn=1
SET @Message=''

declare mycursor cursor for Select SheetNo,SheetSeries, SheetStatus FROM dye.StuffWeight
where SheetSeries=@SheetSeries

open mycursor
 fetch next from mycursor into @SheetNo,@SheetSeries1,@SheetStatus
while(@@fetch_status = 0)

begin
       select @Count=COUNT(*)  FROM dye.StuffWeightDetail WHERE ISNULL(RealQty,0)>0 AND SheetSeries=@SheetSeries1
       if ISNULL(@SheetStatus,0) = 9
          Begin
           select @ireturn=0,@Message='料单号【'+@SheetNo+'】已作废，不能修改!'
          End
       ELSE        
       if @Count > 0
          Begin
           select @ireturn=0,@Message='料单号【'+@SheetNo+'】已经称料,不能修改！'
          End
       else
          Begin
            --允许删除时，并且删除称料表中对应数据                 
          select @ireturn=1,@Message=''
          End
   fetch next from mycursor INTO @SheetNo,@SheetSeries1,@SheetStatus
end

close mycursor	

deallocate mycursor

select @ireturn,@Message

open mycursor
 fetch next from mycursor into @SheetNo
while(@@fetch_status = 0)

begin
    SELECT  @Count=COUNT(*)  FROM dye.StuffOut WHERE  WeightSheetNo=@SheetNo
       if @Count > 0
          Begin
           select @ireturn=0,@Message='称料单号【'+@SheetNo+'】已经领料,不能删除！'
          End
       else
          Begin
                           
          select @ireturn=1,@Message=''
          End
   fetch next from mycursor INTO @SheetNo
end

close mycursor	

deallocate mycursor

select @ireturn,@Message

SET @ireturn=1
SET @Message=''

declare mycursor cursor for Select SheetNo,SheetStatus FROM dye.StuffWeight
where SheetSeries=@SheetSeries

open mycursor
 fetch next from mycursor into @JobSheetNo,@SheetStatus
while(@@fetch_status = 0)

entries.SQL:
SELECT A.*,'' AS DEFECTNAMES,'' AS DEFECTNAMECOUNT,REALQTY+ISNULL(ADDQTY,0) PRINTQTY ,SUMROLLS,''STRWEIGHT,''STRPCODE,''COLNAME,'' AS WEIGHTLIST,JOBSHEETNO AS JOBMAINNO,
'' AS WIDTHLIST,'' AS FULLWIDTHLIST,'' AS YARDNANELIST,'' AS YARDLIST,
(CASE WHEN dye.GET_NUMBER(A.WIDTH)*A.PAYARD=0 THEN NULL ELSE A.DOTS*3600/(A.PAYARD*dye.GET_NUMBER(A.WIDTH)) END)AVGDOTS  FROM DYE.RECORDYIELD  A 
JOIN (SELECT   COUNT( DISTINCT BARCODE)SUMROLLS,JOBSHEETNO AS JOBMAINNO FROM DYE.RECORDYIELD  GROUP BY JOBSHEETNO
)B ON A.JOBSHEETNO = B.JOBMAINNO
 where  1=1  and 1=2

SELECT a.SalerID AS sales, a.SheetSeries,a.SheetNo,a.SheetNo AS DetailNo,'' AS MainNo,a.LotNo AS OrderNo,a.CustomerID, a.Approver,
a.Customer AS CutomerID_R,a.ProdID AS Fabric,a.ColorNum,a.ColorID AS Color,'' AS Memo,a.RightStatus,
a.Width,a.WeightQty,a.Remarks,a.LabelID,a.Weight , ProdWeight,a.Width , ProdRePeatcnt , ProdSkeWing,
ProdWidth,a.SheetDate,IsOver,a.PreRolls AS Rolls,a.PreVatQty,cnt.Recordcnt,prodkg,lengthQyt,Dots, 
Dots as PDots,lengthQyt as PlengthQyt,cnt.Recordcnt as PRolls,cnt.Pkg,
a.Checker,a.ShippingMarkID,25 as GradeDots ,a.CHECKDots,
(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN a.ProdWidth*lengthQyt=0 THEN NULL ELSE Dots*3600/(a.ProdWidth*lengthQyt) END)>16 THEN 'B' ELSE 'A' END ) as Grade,
(CASE WHEN a.ProdWidth*lengthQyt=0 THEN NULL ELSE Dots*3600/(a.ProdWidth*lengthQyt) END)YAvgdots,0.00 as f_Loss
FROM dye.vw_jobsheet a
left Join dye.RecordYield_EmpID re on re.JobSheetNo=a.SheetNo 
left join dye.h_Employee emp1 on re.EmpID=emp1.EmpID 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT COUNT(n.JobMainNo)recordcnt,SUM(CustQty)prodkg,SUM(n.Kg)Pkg,SUM(Dots)Dots,SUM(PAYard)lengthQyt,JobMainNo 
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT BarCode AS BarCodeRollNo,JobSheetNo AS JobMainNo, Dots,CustQty,kg,PAYard
FROM dye.RecordYield 
)n GROUP BY n.JobMainNo)cnt ON cnt.JobMainNo=a.SheetNo
where 1=1 AND 1=2
and a.SheetNo IN (SELECT DISTINCT JobSheetNo FROM dye.RecordYield)
